 # fixture repo

+## Running the tests
+
+There is no test suite yet — the repo currently contains only the modules
+themselves. Tests are expected to live in `tests/` as `test_*.py` files and run
+with [pytest](https://docs.pytest.org/):
+
+```sh
+pip install pytest
+python -m pytest
+```
+
+Until the first test is added, that command exits reporting no tests collected.
